# Invocations WebSocket Protocol Guide

The `invocations_ws` protocol is a **duplex WebSocket pass-through**. After the platform authenticates the upgrade request and routes it to your container, every frame in both directions is forwarded as-is. The agent developer defines the wire format, the framing model, and the streaming semantics.
